free_tier.stated: No hard quota: 'there is no quota for valid use-cases', with a soft review threshold at 750 MiB Git storage and 1.5 GiB packages/LFS/attachments per account.

egress.terms: No egress quota or charge published; Codeberg runs its own pages server (git-pages) and asks users not to be wasteful rather than metering.

tooling: git-pages accepts a direct HTTP upload ('git-pages-cli https://coolcat.wiki --password ... --upload-dir site/') or a Forgejo Actions webhook; any Forgejo host can self-host the same server.
chaining: One account with many repos, each with its own pages branch; unlimited repos per account in practice. But 750 MiB-per-account soft line means the multiplier is accounts, not repos.

limits.value: review threshold at 750 MiB Git storage and 1

limits_note: 750 MiB Git storage and 1.5 GiB packages/LFS/attachments before an admin review request is expected; files under 1 MiB are cached at the edge; each repo gets one pages site.
reliability_note: Codeberg explicitly reviews and can deny 'unreasonable' resource usage — this is a community forge with active human moderation of storage, which is a different reliability class from a commercial CDN.

evidence.proved: 'no quota for valid use-cases', 'If you intend to use more than: 750 MiB for Git storage, 1.5 GiB of packages, LFS and attachments ... request these resources first'
